title: Working From Home
text:
Since 2020, many companies have allowed employees to work from home at least part of the week. Supporters say this saves time, because workers no longer spend hours commuting. Critics, however, argue that it can make teamwork harder and blur the line between work and personal life. Most experts agree that the future will probably combine home and office work.

Human resources managers have noticed that employees who work from home often feel more independent. Some managers, however, worry that newcomers learn more slowly without direct contact with colleagues. For this reason, a growing number of companies ask staff to come to the office two or three days a week. This hybrid model aims to combine the benefits of both systems.

questions.text: Why do supporters say remote work is useful?
options: It saves time because workers do not commute for hours.
It reduces the cost of food.
It removes the need for any meetings.

questions.text: What worry do some managers have?
options: Employees are working too many hours.
Newcomers may learn more slowly without direct contact with colleagues.
Employees are asking for higher salaries.
The office is too expensive to maintain.

questions.text: What can be inferred about the hybrid model?
options: It is preferred by all employees equally.
It attempts to balance the advantages of home and office work.
It will soon replace all office work.
It is only useful for newcomers.

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about companies that require two or three office days?
options: They have decided to close their offices.
They think employees should never work from home.
They believe employees do not need colleagues at all.
They want to keep some of the advantages of in-person work.

to make the difference between two things less clear
able to act or make decisions without help from others
made up of two different things combined together

paragraph_translations: Desde 2020, muitas empresas permitiram que os funcionários trabalhassem de casa pelo menos parte da semana. Os defensores dizem que isso economiza tempo, porque os trabalhadores não passam mais horas no deslocamento. Os críticos, por outro lado, argumentam que isso pode dificultar o trabalho em equipe e confundir a linha entre a vida profissional e a pessoal. A maioria dos especialistas concorda que o futuro provavelmente combinará trabalho em casa e no escritório.

Os gerentes de recursos humanos perceberam que os funcionários que trabalham de casa costumam se sentir mais independentes. Alguns gerentes, no entanto, se preocupam com o fato de que os recém-chegados aprendem mais devagar sem contato direto com os colegas. Por essa razão, um número crescente de empresas pede que os funcionários venham ao escritório dois ou três dias por semana. Esse modelo híbrido pretende combinar as vantagens dos dois sistemas.
